get_gpu_kernel_breakdown: get a breakdown of GPU kernel types and their time distribution across all ranks in a trace
get_gpu_kernels_with_user_annotations: get GPU kernels associated with their closest or leaf GPU user annotation for a specific rank
get_gpu_user_annotation_breakdown: get a summary of time spent by each GPU user annotation with pie charts and bar graphs
get_temporal_breakdown: get a temporal breakdown of idle time, compute time, and non-compute time across all ranks
get_idle_time_breakdown: get a breakdown of GPU idle time by host wait, kernel wait, and other categories per CUDA stream
